name: YOUR_PROJECT_NAME (e.g. Production Apps)
projectID: YOUR_GCP_PROJECT_ID (GCP Console -> Project Selector at top)
bucketName: pubsite_prod_12345678901234567890 (Google Play Console -> Download reports -> Statistics -> Copy Cloud Storage URI -> String right after gs://)
keyFilePath: keys/google_key.json (Path to GCP Service Account JSON key inside data/config/)
keyFilePath_apple: keys/AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 (Path to App Store Connect .p8 key file inside data/config/)
appleIssuerId: YOUR_APPLE_ISSUER_ID_UUID (App Store Connect -> Users and Access -> Integrations (Keys) -> Issuer ID at top)
appleKeyId: YOUR_APPLE_KEY_ID_10_CHARS (App Store Connect -> Users and Access -> Integrations (Keys) -> Key ID next to key)
appleVendorId: YOUR_APPLE_VENDOR_ID_8_DIGITS (App Store Connect -> Payments and Financial Reports -> Vendor Number at top left)
PlaystoreConsoleUrl: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/YOUR_DEVELOPER_ID (URL of your Google Play Console homepage)
timezone: America/New_York (Optional IANA timezone string, e.g. UTC, America/New_York. Defaults to server system time)
